Ravi Sankar S\. Nair\.
Tribal Languages of Kerala\.
*Language in India*, 13\(7\):40–44, July 2013\.
Original chapter heading prints MALADEVA/VEDA; contents prints Malaveda/Veda\. Source warns that Veda/Malaveda/Vettuvar communities may differ and contrasts Pathanamthitta 1977 speech with Kollam 1991 speech\. Individual examples are not explicitly assigned to a locality\. No explicit reuse licence stated\. Literal Roman transcription retained without inferred IPA\.
